description: Layer classification for crates/core/src, read by scripts/ci/core_dep_map.py. A kernel module must not gain dependencies on leaf modules (see core_layers_baseline.json). Modules in `neutral` (or in none of the lists; those are reported as unclassified) are neutral: assembly, analysis and diagnostics layers whose edges are reported but not ratcheted. Node names are produced by core_dep_map.py: top-level modules, peripherals/<dir>, peripherals (files directly in peripherals/), cpu (trait and root) and cpu/<arch>.

notes.peripherals: Kernel: holds the Peripheral engines (spi, i2c, timer, dma, rcc, nvic) and the type-string device factory (generic_factory.rs). The factory and some vendor-named files placed directly in peripherals/ (esp_*, stm32*, ra_*, sam*, rp2*) name vendor types, so most of this node's kernel->leaf edges are that factory; they are the debt this ratchet exists to stop growing.
notes.peripherals/gpio: Kernel: generic GPIO port engine used by every chip. It has no leaf dependencies today.
notes.peripherals/uart: Kernel: generic UART engine. It imports efr32 register types today (baselined).
notes.peripherals/kit: Kernel: the PeripheralKit registry and AttachCtx. It names components kits (baselined).
notes.peripherals/components: Leaf: library of external devices (sensors, displays, modems, drivers) attached through kits. The bus builds some of them directly today (baselined).
notes.peripherals/armv7: Leaf: SoC peripheral models for Zynq/Rockchip-class ARM targets (GIC, DW/Cadence UART, TTC), not the architecture's core peripherals.
notes.peripherals/esp_xtensa_common: Leaf: ESP-specific support shared by Xtensa chips; the Bus trait's ROM thunk type names the Xtensa CPU through it (baselined).
notes.cpu: Kernel: Cpu trait and the cpu module root, which re-exports every architecture and so reaches leaf architectures by name. Edges to leaf architectures from here are re-exports and are baselined.
notes.cpu/cortex_m: Kernel: reaches the concrete SystemBus on hot step paths, so it must stay with or below the bus.
notes.cpu/riscv: Kernel: same reason as cortex_m (downcasts to SystemBus in step code).
notes.cpu/jit_framework: Kernel: shared JIT support used by cortex_m and riscv.
notes.cpu/aarch64: Leaf: not used by the bus in step code. The snapshot module embeds its snapshot type (baselined).
notes.cpu/cortex_a: Leaf: not used by the bus in step code.
notes.cpu/mips: Leaf: not used by the bus in step code. The snapshot module embeds its snapshot type (baselined).
notes.cpu/rx: Leaf: not used by the bus in step code. The snapshot module embeds its snapshot type (baselined).
notes.decoder: Kernel (no imports): instruction decoder shared by the hot CPUs. Classified kernel so it never grows leaf dependencies.
notes.lib: Kernel: items defined in lib.rs (Machine, Bus, SimResult, ...) and its pub use re-exports.
notes.snapshot: Kernel: the CpuSnapshot enum embeds snapshot types defined in leaf CPU modules (baselined).
notes.pins: Kernel: pin model shared by GPIO engines.
notes.analog: Neutral: analog co-simulation layer; not classified until its boundary with the bus is settled.
notes.cosim: Neutral: depends on Machine, so it sits above the kernel.
notes.system: Neutral: chip assembly layer; it names vendor models by design.
notes.boot: Neutral: boot ROM images and chip assembly; vendor-specific by design.
notes.world: Neutral: multi-device scenario layer above the kernel.
notes.session: Neutral: session orchestration above the kernel.
notes.vfi: Neutral: fault-injection layer above the kernel.
notes.physics: Neutral: no imports; not part of the ratchet.
